result.reason: The operative language does not reach either playbook position. Contractor’s cap is changed to 12 months’ fees, but it omits the preferred USD 1,000,000 floor, while Company’s cap remains fees paid without the same 12-month paid-or-payable formulation. More importantly, the introductory exception for “Excluded Claims” applies grammatically only to Contractor’s liability cap, so the listed carve-outs are not mutual. The consequential-damages exclusion also contains no express exception for Excluded Claims. The payment-obligation clarification is included, and the edits are otherwise targeted and preserve the existing structure, but the margin comment inaccurately claims mutuality.
